hookLine: Ranking the most chaotic trampoline fails from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: The trampoline mat tearing and someone sinking right through it.
Number 4: The double bounce that launches you way higher than expected.
Number 3: The whole trampoline getting picked up and flipped over the fence by the wind.
Number 2: Flying clean off the trampoline mid-backflip.
Number 1: Two kids colliding head-on mid-jump at the trampoline park!
